addendum:
## 📖 Added definitions (glossary backfill)

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| WMT14 | WMT14 is a machine translation dataset (German-English) used as a benchmark for conditional text generation tasks. |
| MDLM | MDLM is a discrete diffusion language model that operates directly over categorical tokens and is a strong baseline for unconditional generation. |
| LD4LG | LD4LG is a latent diffusion language model that uses a separately trained decoder to map continuous latents back to tokens. |
| AR | AR refers to autoregressive language models, used as a baseline for conditional generation tasks like machine translation. |
| PLANNER | PLANNER is a latent diffusion language model that requires a separately trained latent-to-text decoder. |
| LDM | LDM refers to latent diffusion models, a style where data is compressed into a latent space for diffusion, requiring a separate decoder. |
| SC | Self-conditioning is the technique of feeding the model's previous prediction back as an extra input to supply a conditioning signal reused for classifier-free guidance without extra inference passes. |
| MAUVE | MAUVE is a diversity and quality metric for generated text mentioned as missing from the evaluation beyond generative perplexity and unigram entropy. |
